items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: I wonder why Henry said that.

ctx.x: He doesn't lie. Oh, no. He doesn't want you to hear it. I wonder why Henry said that. Yeah, why don't we forget it? Yeah, get that out of here. Yeah, we'll rub it off him. Of course, of course. A lot of people don't believe he's good, no.
But when he's feeling good, I know something. Yeah.
